# icenova

> icenova makes playful frozen novelty ice creams that look familiar and taste unexpected.

## Website

- Canonical website: https://eulahwu917.github.io/icenova-website/
- Store locator: Search for retailers carrying icenova by ZIP code, city, state, address, or store name.

## Products featured

- Fried Chicken Ice Cream: Vanilla ice cream, a chocolate bone, and a crunchy golden shell.
- Divine Peach: Peach-flavored novelty ice cream sculpted like a peach.
- Golden Mango: Mango-flavored novelty ice cream sculpted like a mango.
- Strawberry Romance: Strawberry-flavored novelty ice cream.

## Brand naming

Write the brand as "icenova" in one lowercase word.

## Availability

Retail availability can change. Visitors should contact a listed store before making a special trip.
